FINAL IVX PRODUCTION COMPLETION PLAN
EXECUTE ONE ITEM AT A TIME — VERIFY BEFORE MOVING FORWARD

IMPORTANT SCOPE

Complete IVX end to end for:

- Website
- Backend API
- Public chat
- Owner authentication
- Owner audit jobs
- Autonomous worker
- Task recovery
- Freeze-risk remediation
- Treasury and accounting
- Android APK
- iOS build readiness
- Monitoring
- Rollback
- Production proof

DO NOT perform App Store or Google Play submission at this time.

Do not mark the full project complete until every required item below has evidence.

CURRENT AUDIT BASELINE

1. Website: 90%
2. Core API availability: 95%
3. Public chat safety: 85%
4. Owner authentication boundary: 90%
5. Owner audit-job system: 75%
6. Autonomous worker control plane: 70%
7. Autonomous worker end-to-end proof: 35%
8. Task pause/recovery controls: 75%
9. Freeze-risk control: 30%
10. Treasury/accounting logic: 65%
11. Live treasury/tax endpoints: 10%
12. Tax filing compliance: 0%
13. Android distribution readiness: 30%
14. iOS distribution readiness: 35%
15. Monitoring and rollback proof: 60%

Do not repeat duplicate audit items.

==================================================
EXECUTION RULES
==================================================

Complete tasks strictly in this order.

For every task:

1. Inspect current production behavior.
2. Identify the exact root cause.
3. Fix the code or configuration.
4. Run local tests.
5. Commit the fix.
6. Push to GitHub main.
7. Deploy the current commit.
8. Verify the live production result.
9. Attach proof.
10. Mark PASS, PARTIAL, or FAIL.

Do not move to the next item if the current item has a critical failure.

Do not report PASS based only on source code.

PASS requires live production evidence.

==================================================
1. FREEZE THE CURRENT PRODUCTION BASELINE
==================================================

Record the current production state before changing anything.

Required proof:

- GitHub repository
- GitHub branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render service name
- Render service ID
- Current Render deployment ID
- Current Render live SHA
- Current API version SHA
- Current frontend deployment SHA
- Current boot time
- Current rollback commit
- UTC timestamp

Required live checks:

- https://ivxholding.com
- https://ivxholding.com/robots.txt
- https://ivxholding.com/sitemap.xml
- https://api.ivxholding.com/health
- https://api.ivxholding.com/version

Acceptance:

- GitHub HEAD identified.
- Live commit identified.
- Differences between GitHub and production documented.
- A safe rollback point exists.

Status:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

==================================================
2. WEBSITE PRODUCTION VERIFICATION
==================================================

Current score: 90%

Audit:

- Homepage
- robots.txt
- sitemap.xml
- Main navigation
- Registration
- Login links
- Investment cards
- Reels links
- Contact links
- Mobile responsiveness
- Broken assets
- Console errors
- Network failures
- Redirects
- Canonical URLs
- Metadata
- Open Graph data
- Favicon
- IVX logo
- SSL certificate

Required live proof:

- HTTP status for every route
- Screenshots on mobile and desktop
- Browser console output
- Network request summary
- Lighthouse or equivalent performance result
- Timestamp

Acceptance:

- All public website routes return expected statuses.
- No broken image, video, CSS, or JavaScript assets.
- No critical browser-console errors.
- Registration and navigation work.
- robots.txt and sitemap.xml are valid and current.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
3. CORE API AVAILABILITY
==================================================

Current score: 95%

Verify:

- /health
- /version
- API boot sequence
- Database connection
- Supabase connection
- Required environment variables
- Error middleware
- CORS
- Rate limits
- Request IDs
- Structured logs
- Graceful shutdown

Required /health response:

{
  "status": "healthy",
  "service": "ivx-holdings-platform",
  "commit": "<live SHA>",
  "version": "<application version>",
  "bootTime": "<timestamp>"
}

Required proof:

- HTTP 200
- Full sanitized response
- Live SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Startup logs
- No secret values

Acceptance:

- /health returns HTTP 200.
- /version matches the deployed GitHub commit.
- Database and Supabase connections are healthy.
- No startup crash or dependency error exists.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
4. PUBLIC CHAT BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Current score: 85%

The current behavior returns HTTP 200 with a visible STATE: BLOCKED response for unsafe deployment requests.

Verify both normal and protected behavior.

Test:

1. Normal public question
2. Public real-estate question
3. Public request to deploy
4. Public request to access owner settings
5. Public request for secrets
6. Malformed message
7. Empty message
8. Repeated message
9. Long message
10. Multiple simultaneous requests

Required behavior:

- Normal public chat returns HTTP 200 and a useful answer.
- Unauthorized deployment request returns a visible blocked answer.
- No secrets are exposed.
- No owner-only mutation executes.
- No generic HTTP 409 is used for missing authorization.
- Public chat remains usable even if deployment authorization fails.

Required proof:

- Request
- Response
- HTTP status
- Request ID
- Timestamp
- Production URL

Acceptance:

- Public chat works.
- Protected actions remain blocked.
- Public chat and deployment authorization are separated.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
5. OWNER AUTHENTICATION BOUNDARY
==================================================

Current score: 90%

Test:

- Valid owner login
- Invalid password
- Non-owner login
- Expired JWT
- Missing JWT
- Modified JWT
- Logout
- Login again
- Session persistence
- App restart
- Browser refresh
- Owner dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Variables
- Settings
- Deployment approval endpoint
- Worker job endpoint

Expected results:

- Valid owner: authorized
- Missing token: HTTP 401
- Invalid token: HTTP 401
- Expired token: HTTP 401
- Authenticated non-owner: HTTP 403
- Valid owner accessing owner route: HTTP 200

Required proof:

- Sanitized auth logs
- HTTP status for every test
- Owner user ID hash or masked identifier
- No token values
- Screenshots
- Timestamp

Acceptance:

- No owner route is publicly accessible.
- No permanent static token is treated as a Supabase JWT.
- Owner session remains stable.
- No automatic unauthorized owner login exists.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
6. OWNER AUDIT-JOB SYSTEM
==================================================

Current score: 75%

Current condition:

- Owner-authenticated audit-job list works.
- Zero jobs are currently recorded.

Create a real QA-only audit job.

The audit job must:

- Be created by the owner.
- Have a unique job ID.
- Record requested scope.
- Record requested commit.
- Enter queued status.
- Be accepted by the worker.
- Enter running status.
- Produce logs.
- Produce a result.
- Enter completed status.
- Write proof to the ledger.

Required job fields:

- job_id
- owner_id
- action
- requested_commit_sha
- status
- created_at
- started_at
- completed_at
- worker_id
- result
- proof_reference
- error_code
- retry_count

Required proof:

- API response creating job
- Job list before
- Job list after
- Worker log
- Final result
- Proof ledger record

Acceptance:

- At least one fresh audit job completes in production.
- The job is visible in the owner audit-job list.
- The result survives service restart.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
7. AUTONOMOUS WORKER CONTROL PLANE
==================================================

Current score: 70%

Verify live control functions:

- Queue
- Start
- Pause
- Resume
- Cancel
- Retry
- Mark blocked
- Detect stale task
- Recover stale task
- Record proof
- Restrict mutations
- Enforce owner approval
- Enforce approved commit SHA
- Reject replay

Required endpoints:

- Worker status
- Queue status
- Job status
- Pause
- Resume
- Cancel
- Retry
- Proof ledger
- Worker health

Required proof:

- Authorized owner requests
- Unauthorized requests
- State transition logs
- Database records
- Worker heartbeat
- Timestamp

Acceptance:

- Every control action produces the correct state.
- Unauthorized requests return 401 or 403.
- Mutations cannot execute without valid authorization.
- The worker remains alive after restart.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
8. AUTONOMOUS WORKER END-TO-END PROOF
==================================================

Current score: 35%

This is a critical blocker.

Execute one fresh production QA-only job using:

- A valid owner approval
- A single-use approval record
- The exact approved commit SHA
- The dedicated production worker
- Signed worker authentication
- Proof ledger output

The job must not modify financial data.

Recommended QA-only job:

- Call /health
- Call /version
- Verify commit parity
- Verify public chat
- Verify owner route rejects unauthenticated request
- Write the results to the proof ledger

Required lifecycle:

1. Owner creates approval.
2. Approval status = approved.
3. Worker accepts the job.
4. Worker validates commit SHA.
5. Worker consumes the approval once.
6. Job enters running.
7. QA executes.
8. Job enters completed.
9. Approval status becomes consumed.
10. Proof ledger records all evidence.
11. Replay attempt is rejected.

Required proof:

- Approval ID
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Requested SHA
- Executed SHA
- State transitions
- Completion result
- Replay rejection
- Proof ledger record
- Timestamp

Acceptance:

- One fresh job completes end to end in production.
- Approval is single-use.
- Replay is rejected.
- No manual token entry is required during execution.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
9. TASK PAUSE, RECOVERY, AND DISRUPTION DRILL
==================================================

Current score: 75%

Current code supports:

- queued
- running
- paused
- blocked
- cancelled
- stale recovery

Now prove it live.

Run a controlled QA-only disruption drill:

1. Create a long-running test job.
2. Pause it.
3. Confirm worker stops processing.
4. Resume it.
5. Confirm it continues.
6. Create another job.
7. Cancel it.
8. Confirm it cannot resume.
9. Create a stale job.
10. Trigger stale recovery.
11. Confirm duplicate execution does not occur.

Required proof:

- Job state history
- Pause timestamp
- Resume timestamp
- Cancel timestamp
- Recovery timestamp
- Worker logs
- Duplicate-execution check

Acceptance:

- Pause works.
- Resume works.
- Cancel works.
- Stale recovery works.
- No job runs twice.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
10. FREEZE-RISK REMEDIATION
==================================================

Current score: 30%

Current scan found 189 freeze risks.

Do not merely report the number.

Classify all 189 findings:

- Critical
- High
- Medium
- Low
- False positive

Categories:

- Infinite loops
- Unbounded retries
- Missing timeouts
- Unhandled promises
- Deadlocks
- Blocking database calls
- Large synchronous operations
- Missing abort controllers
- Unbounded queues
- Memory leaks
- Realtime subscription leaks
- Duplicate listeners
- Video-processing freezes
- Image-processing freezes
- Chat-render loops
- Navigation loops
- Login spinner loops
- Worker lock failures

Required process:

1. Export all 189 findings.
2. Deduplicate them.
3. Assign severity.
4. Identify file and line.
5. Fix all critical findings.
6. Fix all high findings.
7. Retest.
8. Run the scanner again.
9. Document justified remaining medium/low findings.

Acceptance:

- Zero critical freeze risks.
- Zero high freeze risks.
- No infinite owner-login spinner.
- No reels crash after several minutes.
- No chat UI freeze.
- No worker deadlock.
- Remaining risks are documented and accepted.

Required proof:

- Before scan
- After scan
- Files changed
- Tests run
- Crash and freeze test evidence

Target score: minimum 90%, preferably 100%

==================================================
11. TREASURY AND ACCOUNTING LOGIC
==================================================

Current score: 65%

Current evidence:

- 14 focused local finance tests pass.

Now verify production-safe logic.

Audit:

- Double-entry ledger
- Transaction creation
- Transaction reversal
- Approval requirements
- Investor statements
- Realtor commissions
- Influencer commissions
- Management fees
- Profit distributions
- Reconciliation
- Dashboard totals
- Date filtering
- Currency precision
- Duplicate transaction prevention
- Immutable ledger history
- Audit trail
- Role access

Required tests:

- Balanced journal entry
- Unbalanced journal rejection
- Duplicate payment rejection
- Unauthorized transaction rejection
- Reversal without deletion
- Statement total reconciliation
- Commission calculation
- 1099 aggregation logic
- Dashboard versus ledger parity

Do not use real transfers.

Use QA fixtures or isolated production-safe test records.

Acceptance:

- Ledger remains balanced.
- No transaction can be silently deleted.
- Financial totals reconcile.
- Permissions are enforced.
- Tests pass in the deployed environment.

Target score: 100% logic verification

==================================================
12. FIX LIVE TREASURY ENDPOINT
==================================================

Current score: 10%

Current failure:

- /api/ivx/treasury/audit returns HTTP 500.

Required actions:

1. Reproduce the HTTP 500.
2. Capture request ID.
3. Capture exact stack trace.
4. Identify file and line.
5. Check database schema.
6. Check missing migrations.
7. Check environment variables.
8. Check permissions.
9. Check null data handling.
10. Fix the root cause.
11. Add regression tests.
12. Deploy.
13. Verify live.

Expected result:

- Valid owner request: HTTP 200
- Missing JWT: HTTP 401
- Non-owner JWT: HTTP 403
- Invalid input: HTTP 400 or 422
- Internal failures: structured error with request ID

Required proof:

- Before response
- Error trace
- Fix commit
- Test result
- Live HTTP 200
- Sanitized response
- Timestamp

Target score: 100%

==================================================
13. FIX COMMISSIONS AND 1099 ENDPOINT
==================================================

Current score: 10%

Current failure:

- Commissions/1099 endpoint returns HTTP 500.

Required actions:

- Reproduce failure.
- Capture exact stack trace.
- Verify commissions tables.
- Verify payment recipient records.
- Verify tax-year filtering.
- Verify zero-transaction behavior.
- Verify missing TIN handling.
- Verify aggregation.
- Verify rounding.
- Verify duplicate-payment handling.
- Fix the root cause.
- Add production regression tests.
- Deploy and verify live.

Expected result:

- Valid owner request: HTTP 200
- Missing JWT: HTTP 401
- Non-owner JWT: HTTP 403
- Invalid tax year: HTTP 400
- No records: HTTP 200 with empty result
- Valid records: correct aggregation

Acceptance:

- Endpoint no longer returns HTTP 500.
- Aggregated totals reconcile to commission ledger entries.
- Sensitive tax information is not exposed in logs.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
14. TAX-COMPLIANCE BOUNDARY
==================================================

Current score: 0%

Do not claim that IVX is a tax-compliance or tax-filing system.

The current project has no verified evidence of:

- Tax filing
- Federal submission
- State submission
- Jurisdictional tax calculation
- CPA review
- Tax authority acceptance
- Electronic filing
- Filing confirmation
- Filing reconciliation

Implement a clear product boundary.

Required changes:

- Label reports as accounting support or tax preparation data.
- Add disclaimer that reports require review by a qualified tax professional.
- Do not state that IVX files taxes.
- Do not state that IVX guarantees tax compliance.
- Restrict access to sensitive tax reports.
- Log report generation.
- Allow secure export.
- Record the tax year and generation date.

Acceptance:

- No misleading tax-compliance claims.
- 1099 aggregation is presented as preparation data only.
- CPA or tax-professional review remains required.

This item cannot be marked as tax-filing PASS without external professional and regulatory verification.

==================================================
15. ANDROID APK READINESS
==================================================

Current score: 30%

No Google Play submission is required now.

Build a release-ready direct-install Android APK.

Required actions:

- Remove debug signing.
- Use a secure production keystore.
- Protect keystore secrets.
- Set production application ID.
- Set versionName.
- Set versionCode.
- Use production API URL.
- Remove development menus.
- Remove debug banners.
- Test owner login.
- Test chat.
- Test reels.
- Test members.
- Test uploads.
- Test app restart.
- Test offline recovery.
- Test Android permissions.
- Test deep links.
- Test crash reporting.
- Test on a real Android device.

Required deliverables:

- APK filename
- APK download artifact
- Version
- Build number
- SHA-256 checksum
- Signing certificate fingerprint
- Build ID
- Build timestamp
- Installation proof
- Physical-device screenshots
- Physical-device video or logs
- Crash-free test result

Acceptance:

- APK installs directly.
- APK is production-signed.
- No debug certificate is used.
- Core modules work on a physical Android device.
- No App Store work is required.

Target score: 100% direct-install readiness

==================================================
16. IOS BUILD READINESS
==================================================

Current score: 35%

No App Store or TestFlight submission is required now.

Verify:

- Production bundle identifier
- Production API URL
- Signing configuration
- Entitlements
- Permissions

Acceptance:

- Production build succeeds.
- Core modules operate correctly.
- No store submission is performed.

Target score: at least 90% without store distribution

==================================================
17. MONITORING
==================================================

Current score: 60%

Implement and verify:

- API uptime monitoring
- Website uptime monitoring
- Worker heartbeat
- Job-failure alerts
- HTTP 500 alerts
- Authentication failure thresholds
- Database health alerts
- Queue backlog alerts
- Deployment failure alerts
- Reels crash monitoring
- Chat error monitoring
- Owner-login failure monitoring
- Memory monitoring
- CPU monitoring
- Disk monitoring
- Cold-start monitoring

Required proof:

- Monitoring dashboard
- Alert rules
- Test alert
- Alert delivery timestamp
- Recovery confirmation

Acceptance:

- A forced safe test failure generates an alert.
- The alert contains service, time, endpoint, and request ID.
- No secrets appear in alerts.

Target score: 100%

==================================================
18. RETRY AND DEAD-LETTER QUEUE PROOF
==================================================

Current gap:

- No live retry/dead-letter proof.

Execute a controlled failure test.

Test:

1. Create a QA-only job designed to fail safely.
2. Confirm first failure.
3. Confirm retry count increments.
4. Confirm retry delay applies.
5. Exhaust retry limit.
6. Confirm movement to dead-letter state.
7. Inspect dead-letter record.
8. Correct the test condition.
9. Requeue the job.
10. Confirm successful completion.

Required proof:

- Job ID
- Retry count
- Retry timestamps
- Final dead-letter state
- Requeue action
- Final completion
- Proof ledger record

Acceptance:

- Failed jobs do not disappear.
- Retry is bounded.
- Dead-letter state is visible.
- Recovery succeeds.
- No duplicate financial mutation occurs.

==================================================
19. ROLLBACK PROOF
==================================================

Current score: 60%

Run a controlled non-destructive rollback drill.

Required actions:

1. Record current live SHA.
2. Identify prior stable SHA.
3. Confirm database compatibility.
4. Deploy a safe test change.
5. Verify the safe change.
6. Roll back to the stable SHA.
7. Verify /health and /version.
8. Restore the current approved release if required.
9. Record all deployment IDs.

Required proof:

- Starting SHA
- Test SHA
- Rollback SHA
- Deployment IDs
- Health checks
- Version checks
- Downtime duration
- Timestamp

Acceptance:

- Rollback works.
- API returns healthy after rollback.
- No data is lost.
- Current release can be restored.

Target score: 100%

==================================================

==================================================

Acceptance:

- No missing critical tables.
- No critical integrity violations.

==================================================

==================================================

Acceptance:

- Zero exposed production secrets.
- Zero critical unresolved security findings.
- Zero unauthorized production mutation paths.

==================================================

==================================================

Run one complete final test using the deployed production system.

==================================================
